2054. Binary Search Tree - Find Height

Problem Statement
Create a Binary Search Tree from given integers and find the height of the tree.
Description
Read n integers and insert them into a Binary Search Tree. Find the height of the tree, where a tree containing only the root node has height 0. The height is the maximum number of edges from the root to any leaf.
input_spec: The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers to be inserted into the Binary Search Tree.
output_spec: Print the height of the Binary Search Tree.
